mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `erp_shop`, shopify_token WHERE erp_shop.auth_id = shopify_token.id AND `name` = #{storeName}
select erp_shop.name, shopify_token.access_token from erp_shop join shopify_token on erp_shop.auth_id = shopify_token.id where erp_shop.deleted = 0 and erp_shop.plat_name = 'Shopify'
